title: Phase 1: Multi-Page Infrastructure
description:
Create shared app header with navigation tabs, mobile hamburger menu, and update root layout.

## Scope
- Create /components/layout/app-header.tsx (shared header with nav tabs)
- Create /components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx (mobile drawer navigation)
- Update /app/layout.tsx (add AppHeader to root layout)
- Update /app/page.tsx (remove local Header component)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Can navigate between Dashboard (/) and Portfolio Info (/portfolio-info) using header tabs
- [ ] Active tab shows purple underline on desktop
- [ ] Mobile shows hamburger menu that opens drawer with navigation
- [ ] Mobile drawer closes when route changes
- [ ] Header is sticky and has backdrop blur effect
- [ ] Matches existing dark aesthetic (zinc-950, purple accent)
- [ ] No console errors in browser

## Reference
Plan: docs/plans/2026-01-08-portfolio-info-feature.md (Phase 1, steps 1-5)

## Testing
- Load http://localhost:3000 and verify header appears
- Click between Dashboard/Portfolio Info tabs
- Resize to mobile (<768px) and test hamburger menu
- Verify styling matches existing design system

title: Phase 2: Content System & Markdown Processing
description:
Set up markdown-based content management system with parsing utilities.

## Scope
- Create /content/portfolio/ directory with 3 markdown files:
  - 01-philosophy.md (investment philosophy)
  - 02-strategy-mandate.md (strategy, objectives, rules)
  - 03-about.md (fund background, team)
- Install dependencies: remark, remark-html, gray-matter
- Create /lib/portfolio-content.ts (markdown parsing utilities)
- Add TypeScript types for content structure

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] /content/portfolio/ directory exists with 3 markdown files
- [ ] Markdown files have valid YAML frontmatter (title, order, icon, accent)
- [ ] Content includes examples from plan (headings, lists, tables, blockquotes)
- [ ] Dependencies installed in package.json
- [ ] portfolio-content.ts successfully parses markdown to HTML
- [ ] portfolio-content.ts extracts frontmatter metadata
- [ ] TypeScript types defined for PortfolioSection interface
- [ ] Can run simple test/example to verify parsing works

## Reference
Plan: docs/plans/2026-01-08-portfolio-info-feature.md (Phase 2, steps 6-9)
See plan for full markdown content examples

## Testing
- Run parsing function on sample markdown file
- Verify frontmatter extracted correctly
- Verify HTML output is clean and structured
- Check TypeScript compilation passes

title: Phase 5: Polish, Testing & Build Verification
description:
Final polish, comprehensive testing, and production build verification.

## Scope
- Add loading states and error handling for markdown parsing
- Cross-browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)
- Responsive behavior verification across all breakpoints
- End-to-end navigation flow testing
- Production build verification
- Performance check (bundle size, animations)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Loading state shows while markdown content loads
- [ ] Error boundaries handle markdown parsing failures gracefully
- [ ] Navigation flow Dashboard ↔ Portfolio Info works seamlessly
- [ ] Browser back/forward buttons work correctly
- [ ] URL updates correctly (/, /portfolio-info)
- [ ] Mobile hamburger menu closes on route change
- [ ] make build succeeds with no errors
- [ ] make web runs successfully in dev mode
- [ ] Bundle size increase <50KB gzipped (markdown deps)
- [ ] Static export works (no server-side dependencies)
- [ ] No console errors or warnings
- [ ] Animations are smooth (60fps, no jank)
- [ ] Typography readable and hierarchy clear on all devices
- [ ] Backdrop blur works in Safari
- [ ] All markdown features render (headings, lists, tables, quotes, code)

## Reference
Plan: docs/plans/2026-01-08-portfolio-info-feature.md (Phase 5, steps 18-23)
See Verification & Testing section for full E2E test flow

## Testing Checklist
1. Multi-Page Navigation (header tabs, active highlighting, mobile menu)
2. Content Management (edit markdown, verify changes appear)
3. Visual Rendering (typography, colors, spacing, animations)
4. Section Navigation (sidebar sticky, tabs, smooth scroll, active highlight)
5. Responsive Behavior (mobile/tablet/desktop breakpoints)
6. Build & Integration (make build, bundle size, static export)
7. Cross-Browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)

## Definition of Done
- All acceptance criteria checked
- make build passes
- No console errors
- Feature ready for production deployment

title: Phase 4: Portfolio Info Page Integration
description:
Create portfolio info page route and wire up all components with animations.

## Scope
- Create /app/portfolio-info/page.tsx (main page route)
- Integrate markdown content loading
- Implement section navigation (sidebar + mobile tabs)
- Add Framer Motion animations (fade-in, stagger, smooth scroll)
- Connect all portfolio components together

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] /portfolio-info route accessible and renders without errors
- [ ] Page loads all 3 markdown sections (Philosophy, Strategy, About)
- [ ] Desktop (≥1024px): Shows sticky sidebar navigation on left
- [ ] Mobile (<768px): Shows tab navigation at top
- [ ] Clicking nav items smoothly scrolls to sections
- [ ] Active section highlights in navigation as user scrolls
- [ ] Framer Motion fade-in animation on page load with stagger
- [ ] Section accent bars visible (purple, blue, emerald)
- [ ] All markdown content renders correctly (headings, lists, tables, quotes)
- [ ] Responsive layout works at all breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop)

## Reference
Plan: docs/plans/2026-01-08-portfolio-info-feature.md (Phase 4, steps 14-17)
See Detailed Component Design section for layout mockups

## Testing
- Navigate to http://localhost:3000/portfolio-info
- Scroll through all sections and verify navigation highlights
- Click nav items and verify smooth scroll
- Test on mobile (<768px), tablet (768-1024px), desktop (>1024px)
- Verify animations are smooth (no jank)
- Check console for errors

title: Phase 3: Portfolio Info UI Components
description:
Build reusable UI components for portfolio info display with custom styling.

## Scope
- Create /components/portfolio/markdown-content.tsx (styled prose wrapper)
- Create /components/portfolio/portfolio-section.tsx (section rendering with accent bars)
- Create /components/portfolio/section-navigation.tsx (desktop sidebar + mobile tabs)
- Update /app/globals.css (add .portfolio-prose styles, section accents)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] MarkdownContent component renders parsed HTML with custom prose styling
- [ ] Typography hierarchy matches spec (H1: 5xl, H2: 4xl, H3: 2xl, Bricolage Grotesque)
- [ ] PortfolioSection shows 4-6px left accent bar in section color (purple/blue/emerald)
- [ ] Section numbers (01, 02, 03) display in zinc-500 monospace
- [ ] Blockquotes have left border in accent color + zinc-800/50 background
- [ ] Tables match dashboard styling (zebra striping, monospace numbers)
- [ ] SectionNavigation has sticky sidebar (desktop) and tabs (mobile)
- [ ] Lists have custom colored bullets matching section accent
- [ ] All styles use existing design tokens (zinc colors, spacing scale)

## Reference
Plan: docs/plans/2026-01-08-portfolio-info-feature.md (Phase 3, steps 10-13)
See Design Specifications section for exact typography/spacing/colors

## Testing
- Render component with sample markdown content
- Verify typography scales correctly on mobile/tablet/desktop
- Check accent colors match (purple=#7c3aed, blue=#3b82f6, emerald=#10b981)
- Test sticky sidebar behavior on desktop
- Verify section nav highlights active section
